# Spar 0.7.4

**Spar 0.7.4 changes how the coach chooses and writes your challenges. Spar's
own problems now read like real problems instead of a list of instructions,
and the coach is quicker to hand you the real problem instead of another
warm-up.**

## Problems that read like problems

- **Spar problems are written the way LeetCode's are.** You get a situation
  when it helps, terms explained in words, one clear goal and worked
  examples, instead of "Implement `Solution.x`" followed by a column of rules.
- **The statement doesn't give the method away.** A problem about heaps no
  longer tells you to "use a min-heap with negated priorities". Working out
  what to reach for is part of the problem again. When cost matters, the
  constraints say so.
- **Requirements appear once.** When a challenge does insist on how it's
  solved, that shows once under "How this must be solved", not repeated in
  the statement as well.
- Syntax and API drills, repairs and project tasks still use plain
  step-by-step instructions, because there the steps are the exercise.

## Fewer detours

- **Less stacking of warm-ups.** The coach no longer has to set a smaller
  Spar problem in front of every LeetCode problem. When you're ready for the
  real one, you get it.
- **No more near-repeats.** A problem whose solution you were already shown
  doesn't come back as your next test of the same idea.
- **Real problems outside your usual range can be assigned.** The coach sees
  where a problem sits against your rating and decides, rather than being
  blocked.
- **Lenses fit where they help.** Lenses you set to drill still shape
  problems, but not every problem is bent around one, and replies don't
  list every lens each time.

## Honest progress

- **Progress reflects how you got there.** A pass after hints, or after
  seeing the answer, now counts as assisted, so your abilities and rating
  don't jump on it.
- **Evidence counts are right.** Abilities no longer show "0 evidence" when
  the coach has recorded evidence for them.

## Faster turns

- After you solve something, the coach no longer runs through a fixed
  checklist every time. It does what that solve calls for and replies
  sooner.
- A challenge with an over-long requirement used to be built and then thrown
  away about a minute later. It's now caught before the build starts.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.7.4-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.7.4.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.7.4-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.7.4-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.7.4-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch of a downloaded installer. Updates
  installed from inside Spar don't ask again.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations stay managed by the system package manager.
